args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE single NEW landscape 4:3 iPad opening-flight target image, ideally 2048 x 1536 PNG. A beautiful high oblique aerial overview of the ENTIRE FORBIDDEN CITY, looking FROM SOUTH TO NORTH, not a close gate view, diagram, map, collage or screenshot.
Reference roles: Image 1, approved loading art #807, supplies ONLY the polished stylized 3D visual quality, sunlight, red plaster / gray stone / golden roof palette. Image 2, approved #810 palace square, supplies the architectural material language and pale stone courtyards. Image 3, approved #810 Meridian Gate, supplies the foreground gateway's red-and-gold visual family and projecting wings. None is an edit target or an exact site-plan/camera reference. Do NOT include their Puyi character, their close view, their plaque glyphs or any motion blur.
PRIMARY SCENE: begin the game's aerial opening flight at a distant bird's-eye viewpoint notionally around 300-500 meters above ground and looking obliquely down from the SOUTH toward the NORTH. Pull back sufficiently to see the WHOLE rectangular palace enclosure and the moat OUTSIDE it on ALL FOUR sides. Keep the entire south gate and all FOUR corner towers inside the image, with framing room. This is a vast palace city with densely packed traditional courtyard compounds and many yellow roofs, not five isolated huge fantasy temples in an empty field.
COMPOSITION AND STRUCTURE: South is at the bottom of the image, north toward the top. Wumen / the Meridian Gate is the recognizable prominent gateway at lower center in the FOREGROUND: central gatehouse plus TWO projecting arms making a U-shaped forecourt on its south-facing approach. Past Wumen, look along the central north-south spine through successive ceremonial courtyards and halls: broad pale paved Outer Court in the southern half, the main three halls on the central spine, and denser smaller Inner Court palaces and symmetrical side compounds farther north. The northern garden and northern gate are at the far end. Preserve a coherent single city perimeter with connected red walls, four distinct ornate corner pavilions, gates and a continuous calm blue-green MOAT outside the rectangle. Small traditional bridges cross the moat at approaches; no modern roads.
JINGSHAN: immediately BEHIND the north end, outside and beyond the northern moat, show a single recognizable gently elongated wooded Jingshan hill with small traditional yellow-roofed pavilions, including a higher central summit pavilion. The hill is in the BACKGROUND near the horizon, not inside the palace courtyard and not a distant mountain range. Frame enough sky and hill above the north wall.
MATERIALS AND LIGHT: exactly the same sunny warm daylight, clear blue sky, rich red palace plaster and conspicuous GRAY STONE LOWER WALL/PLINTH courses, golden-yellow GLAZED tiled roofs, blue/green painted wooden brackets and pale stone courtyards as the approved illustrations. High-quality physically plausible stylized 3D game environment, crisp individual roof forms and restrained natural surface detail. Maintain aerial scale; do not turn paving into enormous checkerboard tiles. Soft natural variation in trees, no repeated cauliflower blobs or artificial patterned foliage. Calm moat water and plausible sun/shadow direction.
At this scale this is an opening-flight overview, NOT the 4-6m gameplay camera used in the six previous views. The SOUTH GATE is nearest; the NORTH HILL is farthest. All palace corners, moat and main hall sequence must fit comfortably within the landscape 4:3 image.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: NO people or characters anywhere, no Puyi/emperor, no crowds, no guards, no animals, no collectibles or vehicles. NO modern buildings, skyline, skyscrapers, modern roads, electric poles, cranes, construction sites, flags, advertisements, UI or HUD. NO text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, calligraphy, labels or logos. Omit signboards or leave every tiny plaque completely blank, including Wumen's plaque; decorative brackets must not form text-like glyphs. NO motion blur or speed streaks; no fog hiding architecture. No readable writing, no borders, no map legend, no compass symbol.
Final check: one finished wide 4:3 aerial panorama of the WHOLE Forbidden City from south to north, Wumen foreground, hall rows through the middle, full rectangular wall/moat/corner towers, wooded Jingshan behind, approved sunny red/gray/gold style, no characters and no lettering.
